parties: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited (SPICL) acquiring Tamilnadu PetroProducts Limited (TNPETRO)
headline: SPICL Takeover of TNPETRO: SEBI Reg 31(4) Disclosure Filed
sum: Southern Petrochemical Industries Corporation Limited filed a SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure on NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of ≥25% voting capital in Tamilnadu PetroProducts Limited. The disclosure triggered mandatory reporting under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
implication: SEBI Reg 31(4) filing confirms crossing of 25% threshold; counsel must review open offer obligation timeline, exemption claims (if any under Reg 12), and competing disclosure obligations under Insider Trading Code during the standstill period.
detail: SPICL, a petrochemical manufacturer, has acquired or announced acquisition of substantial voting capital in TNPETRO, triggering mandatory disclosure under SEBI SAT Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), which requires filing within 2 working days of acquisition or announcement of ≥25% voting capital or control. The NSE filing dated 18 Jun 2026 formalises this notice. The full transaction structure, consideration amount, acquisition date, and timing of any mandatory open offer remain to be disclosed in the formal takeover announcement or offer document. No exemption claim is evident from the Reg 31(4) filing alone.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandates disclosure within 2 working days of acquisition or announcement of ≥25% voting capital or control; sets form and exchange-filing requirement.

framework.ref: SEBI SAT Regulations 2011, Regulation 10 (open offer trigger & timeline)
framework.note: 25% threshold triggers mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders at highest price paid in preceding 6-12 months, unless exempted.
Exemptions available (e.g., acquisition from single promoter, preferential allotment, creeping acquisition ≤5% p.a.) - must be verified and claimed in offer document.

framework.ref: SEBI SAT Regulations 2011, Regulation 3 & 4 (definitions & trigger events)
framework.note: Defines 'control' and 'acquisition' including indirect holding, concert party, and deemed control scenarios.
Trading restrictions and disclosures apply to material non-public information (MNPI) regarding acquisition; standstill period may apply.
Post-acquisition, SPICL's relationship with TNPETRO (subsidiary, associate, JV) will determine consolidated financial reporting and related-party rules.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement (NSE) / SEBI (Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: TNPETRO must disclose material events (change of control) to exchange within 30 minutes of occurrence or prior announcement.

framework.ref: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) Merger & Acquisition e-Form (if applicable)
framework.note: If post-acquisition merger or scheme contemplated, MCA filing may be required under Companies Act 2013.

conditions: Acquisition of ≥25% voting capital in TNPETRO by SPICL (threshold trigger)
approvals: SEBI Takeover Code compliance (Regulation 31(4) filing lodged)
Mandatory open offer to remaining shareholders (if not exempted)
Possible NCLT/CCI clearance (if merger/consolidation contemplated post-acquisition)
Stock exchange approval of offer document (within 21 days of filing)
structure.novel: Standard SEBI SAT threshold crossing; no novel structuring apparent from Reg 31(4) disclosure alone.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
triggers.note: ≥25% voting capital threshold triggers mandatory 2-working-day disclosure requirement; filed 18 Jun 2026 with NSE.
Acquisition of ≥25% triggers mandatory open offer obligation (unless exemption under Reg 12 applies) at highest price paid in preceding 6-12 months.
Material information regarding acquisition is MNPI; trading restrictions and disclosure obligations apply to SPICL insiders and board during standstill.
